label: 1. Impact Crater & Terraced Rim Analysis (Boguslawsky)
query: Identify the prominent impact crater rims and evaluate the terraced wall slope features.
why_it_matters: Critical for Artemis/Chandrayaan landing site hazard avoidance, characterizing boulder distribution and steep slope hazards.

label: 2. Permanently Shadowed Region (PSR) Detection (Shackleton Rim)
query: Detect deep shadowed pockets and candidate permanently shadowed cold-traps for volatiles.
why_it_matters: Assists ISRO and international science teams in mapping volatile cold-traps and lunar south pole water-ice reservoirs.

label: 3. Regolith Texture & Immature Ejecta Rays
query: Characterize the regolith grain texture and map the radial ejecta ray distribution.
why_it_matters: Determines surface maturity, space weathering extent, and trafficability for lunar roving vehicles.
